_about: V3 = one B2 filter with a firm head-IMU zero-velocity constraint and locomotion-boosted process noise, cohort 2026c (wiser/scripts/analyze_wiser_v3.py; plan implementation_plan/2026-10-03-wiser-v3.md, approved by the user 2026-10-03 '做', committed 26a1cb8 before any V3 number). Periods, animals, exclusions, IMU seconds and certified still segments are the failure audit's (audit_config / audit_run); S1/S4/S5 definitions are the default-smoother step's (default_smoother_config); the clean-WISER speed reference (clean seconds, u3/u1, noise floor) is step B's (speed_proxy_config / speed_proxy_run); B2 = the smoothing pilot's tuned B2 (smoothing_config -> tuned.B2), unchanged; the locomotion multiplier x10 is the pilot's tuned m_loco (tuned.V2.mult[3]), unchanged. Candidate, sensitivities, thresholds and the decision rule are the plan's and must not be changed after a result. Nothing is tuned in this step. The run writes its verdict into `decision`. A new cohort = a new copy of this file + a re-run.

v3.base: tuned.B2 of smoothing_config: q 3 in^2/s^3, anchors_used noise table, chi2 gate (13.8155) + 2 Huber IRLS passes (k_H 2.5), forward KF + RTS
v3.loco_rule: q x loco_mult on a step (t[k-1], t[k]] whose midpoint second has the audit's state 3 (IMU-QC-ok and locomoting, pilot rule); x 1 on every other step (still, active, QC-failed, the +-10-min margins without IMU seconds)
v3.zupt_rule: pseudo-measurements 0 = v_x, 0 = v_y at every fix whose aligned time lies in a run of >= 3 consecutive IMU-QC-ok still seconds shortened by 1 s at each end; Huber weight inside the IRLS passes as in V1b; no release

context_tracks.B2: rebuilt here by the V3 kernel with multiplier 1 and no ZUPT (= the pilot's B2)
context_tracks.V1b: the V1b run's saved track (current default for the implanted animals)
context_tracks.V2b: the default-smoother run's deployable V2b (IMU-switched q x (1, 0.01, 0.3, 10) on B2, spliced to B2 where the IMU QC fails)

acceptance._rule: V3 passes T1 (|d95| <= 3 % on step B's clean seconds of the six nights, 3-s scale, (a) all clean seconds and (b) the > 15 in/s band of the reference) and T2 (0 jumps in the primary certified still segments, calm and rain, and over the analysis mask of every audit period) and T3 (median per-event lag(V3) - lag(B2) <= +0.5 s for S5 onsets and offsets, calm and rain, all periods; earlier allowed) -> V3 replaces V1b as the default WISER track for the implanted animals (IMU-QC-ok stretches; B2 elsewhere by construction), B2 stays the universal baseline; any failure -> V1b stays the default. Point estimates decide; CIs reported. No sensitivity variant is promoted (a passing variant is a proposal to the user).

jitter_check.floor_source: step-B tables/noise_floor.csv, kind all, set all, scale 3, p95 (1.64 in/s)
jitter_check._note: (i) IMU-active seconds >= 3 s from any locomoting step or ZUPT fix of V3; (ii) clean seconds with IMU state locomoting and u3 below the floor p95

bootstrap._note: 10-min animal-period blocks drawn with replacement within each set; paired = the same draw for every method

decision.where: SF07-SF12 wherever the IMU QC passes (V3 is B2 by construction elsewhere)
